outputs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original fantasy battle sprite animation sheet. Reference Rivet Hound: FOUR-legged mechanical dog with angular dark iron plates, brass riveted edging and linkage bars, blue-steel cylindrical hip/shoulder joints, three-toed metal paws, long segmented brass/iron tail ending triangular spear tip, wedge head with two dorsal fins, orange eye slit and three orange side vents, short forward orange-tipped drill/spike snout. No organic fur or human rider. Twelve complete articulated poses in FOUR columns THREE rows, fixed three-quarter facing screen right, constant body/head/tail scale, generous gutters. Transparent RGBA background. Reading order: 1 alert idle planted paws; 2 idle suspension rises head turns slightly tail lifts; 3 run extended near forepaw forward near hind back; 4 gathered running suspension all knees flex beneath torso; 5 opposite diagonal stride far forepaw forward near forepaw back; 6 attack crouch head pulled back drill aimed forward; 7 lunging drill strike head extended straight right forepaws reaching hindlegs driving; 8 defense low body paws planted head protects front; 9 hit recoil body tilted back head pulled aside; 10 death front joints buckle chest drops; 11 collapse onto side all legs fold tail settles; 12 inert side-lying wreck all FOUR legs tail and drill retained eyes/vents/drill dark unlit orange-brown. Exact same plating, four limbs, tail segments and drill/head dimensions throughout. No sparks, beams, smoke, ground shadows, scenery, labels or gore. Original detailed painted game art matching reference, joint articulation not translated copies. Full tail/paws/snouts inside each cell.
